channel.title: Pier & Point · Nancy & Stephen Grand Family House
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Nancy & Stephen Grand Family House (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Nancy & Stephen Grand Family House: Nancy & Stephen Grand Family House now uses its Assessor lot lines.
item.description: Nancy & Stephen Grand Family House now uses its Assessor lot lines. Source: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lot 8711227.

item.title: Correction · Nancy & Stephen Grand Family House: The map notes said OCII's commission meeting was March 18; OCII's own Resolution No. 10-2014 is dated March 4, 2014, and the notes now say so (and that Citizen Portal is an automated summary, not a primary source). The 2012 parcel recording date now cites the DataSF Parcels record. The record said Family House serves children treated at UCSF Benioff Children's Hospital; OCII's resolution says families of patients primarily treated at UCSF Mission Bay Medical Center, so the summary and notes now use that wording. Founding year, the earlier Judah St. building, nightly capacity, families served and 'low-income-qualified' were removed because no readable cited page states them. The summary's ~92,000 sq ft was replaced by the Assessor's 89,197 sq ft with OCII's planned 96,000 sq ft noted, the Nancy & Stephen Grand name now cites Family House's rooms page, and the milestone no longer calls OCII successor to the 'Mission Bay Redevelopment Agency'. The Wikimedia aerial credit names only the Commons username Firstcultural. The May 2016 opening rests on a UCSF page that blocks automated fetches and remains listed among the record's open questions.
